alexander.name: Alexander
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker filled with ice.
Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
garnish: Sprinkle freshly grated nutmeg on top.

americano.name: Americano
method: Mix the ingredients directly in an old-fashioned glass with ice.
Add a splash of soda water. Stir gently.
garnish: Garnish with half an orange slice and a little lemon peel.

angel-face.name: Angel Face
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker filled with ice.
Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

aviation.name: Aviation
method: Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker.
Shake with cracked ice and pour into a chilled cocktail glass.

bees-knees.name: Bee’s Knees
method: Stir the honey syrup with the lemon and orange juices until fully dissolved; add the dry gin and shake with ice. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
garnish: Garnish with lemon or orange peel, if desired.

bellini.name: Bellini
method: Pour the white peach purée into a mixing glass with ice and add the Prosecco.
Stir gently and pour into a chilled flute.
Note: Puccini uses fresh mandarin juice; Rossini uses fresh strawberry purée; Tintoretto uses fresh pomegranate juice.

between-the-sheets.name: Between the Sheets
method: Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker.
Add ice, shake, and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

black-russian.name: Black Russian
method: Pour the ingredients into an old-fashioned glass filled with ice.
Stir gently. Strain into another old-fashioned glass with ice.
Note: for a White Russian, gently float fresh cream on top and stir slowly.

bloody-mary.name: Bloody Mary
ingredients: Tabasco, celery salt and pepper, to taste
method: Stir all ingredients gently with ice in a mixing glass and pour into a rocks glass.
If served with ice, pour into a highball glass.

boulevardier.name: Boulevardier
ingredients: 30 ml sweet red Monte Carlo wine
method: Pour all ingredients into a mixing glass with ice.
Stir well and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
garnish: Garnish with orange peel; lemon peel may also be added.

bramble.name: Bramble
method: Shake all ingredients except the blackberry liqueur with ice in a shaker, then strain into an old-fashioned glass filled with crushed ice.
Drizzle the blackberry liqueur over the top in a circular motion.
garnish: A lemon slice and blackberries, if desired.

brandy-crusta.name: Brandy Crusta
method: Mix all ingredients with ice in a mixing glass.
Strain into the prepared slender cocktail glass.
garnish: Rub the rim with an orange or lemon slice.
Dip the rim in fine white sugar so the grains adhere.
Carefully place a curl of orange or lemon peel inside the glass.

caipirinha.name: Caipirinha
method: Place the lemon and white sugar in a double old-fashioned glass and muddle gently.
Fill with crushed ice and add the cachaça. Stir gently to combine.
For Caipiroska replace cachaça with vodka; for Caipirissima use rum; for Caipirão use Licor Beirão.

canchanchara.name: Canchanchara
method: Mix the honey with water and lime juice and coat the bottom and sides of the glass with the mixture.
Add crushed ice, then the spirit.
Finally stir vigorously from the bottom upward.

cardinale.name: Cardinale
method: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice and stir well.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

casino.name: Casino
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a cocktail shaker and strain into a chilled rocks glass filled with ice.
garnish: Garnish with lemon peel and a maraschino cherry.

champagne-cocktail.name: Champagne Cocktail
ingredients: a few drops of Grand Marnier (optional)
method: Place the sugar cube in a large champagne glass, add two drops of bitters and the cognac.
Gently pour in the chilled champagne.
garnish: Garnish with orange peel and a cherry.

chartreuse-swizzle.name: Chartreuse Swizzle
method: Pour all ingredients into a tall glass and add crushed ice.
Swizzle vigorously with a swizzle stick or bar spoon, then add more crushed ice to fill the glass.
garnish: Garnish with mint leaves and grated nutmeg.

clover-club.name: Clover Club
ingredients: a few drops of egg white
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

corpse-reviver-2.name: Corpse Reviver #2
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice.
Shake well and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cosmopolitan.name: Cosmopolitan
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker filled with ice.
Shake and strain into a large cocktail glass.
garnish: Garnish with a twist of lemon peel.

cuba-libre.name: Cuba Libre
method: Pour all ingredients directly into a highball glass with ice.

daiquiri.name: Daiquiri
method: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Add ice, shake, and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

dark-n-stormy.name: Dark ’n’ Stormy
method: Pour ginger beer into an ice-filled highball glass and float the rum on top.
garnish: Garnish with a lemon wedge or slice.

dons-special-daiquiri.name: Don’s Special Daiquiri
method: Mix with crushed ice in a milkshake mixer for a few seconds and pour into a stemmed glass.
Fill the glass with more crushed ice.
garnish: Garnish with half a passion fruit.

dry-martini.name: Dry Martini
garnish: Express the lemon peel oils over the drink, or garnish with a green olive if requested.

espresso-martini.name: Espresso Martini
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

fernandito.name: Fernandito
method: Pour the Fernet brandy into a double old-fashioned glass with ice, top with cola and stir gently.

french-75.name: French 75
method: Pour all ingredients except champagne into a shaker.
Shake and strain into a champagne flute.
Top up with champagne.
Stir gently.

french-connection.name: French Connection
method: Pour all ingredients directly into an old-fashioned glass with ice.
Stir gently.

french-martini.name: French Martini
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
garnish: Express lemon peel over the drink to release its oils.

garibaldi.name: Garibaldi
method: Put all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.

gin-basil-smash.name: Gin Basil Smash
method: Put all ingredients and ice in a cocktail shaker.
Shake vigorously and pour into a chilled cocktail glass.

gin-fizz.name: Gin Fizz
method: Shake all ingredients except soda water with ice.
Pour into a slender tumbler and add a splash of soda water.
Note: serve without ice.
garnish: Garnish with a lemon slice; lemon peel is optional.

grand-margarita.name: Grand Margarita
method: Rim a rocks glass with fine sea salt.
Pour the ingredients into a shaker.
Add ice to the glass and the shaker.
Shake vigorously for 10 seconds and strain into the glass.

grasshopper.name: Grasshopper
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice.
Shake vigorously for a few seconds and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

hanky-panky.name: Hanky Panky
method: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice and stir well.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

hemingway-special.name: Hemingway Special
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice.
Shake and strain into a large cocktail glass.

horses-neck.name: Horse’s Neck
ingredients: a few drops of Angostura bitters (optional)
method: Pour the cognac and ginger ale directly into a stemmed glass with ice.
Stir gently.
Add a few drops of Angostura bitters if desired.
garnish: Garnish with a spiral of lemon peel.

iba-tiki.name: IBA Tiki
method: Muddle a thin slice of fresh ginger in a shaker, then add all remaining ingredients.
Shake the shaker vigorously and add ice.
Strain into a chilled tiki mug filled with crushed ice.
garnish: Garnish with citrus slices and dried pineapple slices.

illegal.name: Illegal
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker and shake vigorously with ice.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass, or serve over ice in a traditional clay or ceramic cup.

irish-coffee.name: Irish Coffee
method: Pour hot coffee into a preheated Irish coffee glass.
Add the whiskey and at least one teaspoon of sugar, stirring until the sugar dissolves completely.
Carefully pour chilled thick fresh cream over the back of a spoon held just above the coffee.
The cream should float on the coffee as a separate layer.
Sugar syrup may replace ordinary caster sugar.

john-collins.name: John Collins
method: Pour all ingredients directly into a highball glass with ice and stir gently.
Note: use Old Tom gin to make a Tom Collins.
garnish: Garnish with a lemon slice and a cherry.

jungle-bird.name: Jungle Bird
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker.
Strain into a rocks glass filled with ice.

kir.name: Kir
method: Pour the blackcurrant liqueur into the glass, then add the white wine.
Note: for Kir Royal, replace the white wine with champagne.

last-word.name: Last Word
method: Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker.
Add ice, shake, and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

lemon-drop-martini.name: Lemon Drop Martini
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice.
Stir and pour into a chilled cocktail glass.

long-island-iced-tea.name: Long Island Iced Tea
method: Put all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
Stir gently.

mai-tai.name: Mai-Tai
method: Pour all ingredients into a mixing glass with ice.
Shake and pour into a double rocks or highball glass.
* Trader Vic’s Martinique brown-sugar rum was not agricole rum, but a molasses-based rum.
garnish: Garnish with a pineapple slice, mint leaves and lime peel.

manhattan.name: Manhattan
method: Pour all ingredients into a mixing glass with ice.
Stir well and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

margarita.name: Margarita
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice.
Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

martinez.name: Martinez
method: Pour all ingredients into a mixing glass with ice.
Stir well and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

mary-pickford.name: Mary Pickford
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

mimosa.name: Mimosa
method: Pour the orange juice into a flute, then slowly add the sparkling wine.
Stir gently.
Note: this drink is also known as Buck’s Fizz.

mint-julep.name: Mint Julep
method: Gently muddle the mint, sugar and water in a stainless-steel julep cup.
Fill with crushed ice, add the bourbon and stir until the cup frosts.
garnish: Garnish with a sprig of mint.

missionarys-downfall.name: Missionary’s Downfall
method: Blend all ingredients with half a cup of crushed ice.
Pour into a large glass and garnish.
garnish: Garnish with a mint sprig and a pineapple slice.

mojito.name: Mojito
method: Mix the mint sprigs with the sugar and lime juice.
Add a splash of soda water and fill the glass with ice.
Pour in the rum, top with soda water and stir gently to combine.
garnish: Garnish with a mint sprig and a lime slice.

monkey-gland.name: Monkey Gland
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

moscow-mule.name: Moscow Mule
method: Combine the vodka and ginger beer in a copper mug or rocks glass.
Add the lime juice and stir gently to combine all ingredients.

naked-and-famous.name: Naked and Famous
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

negroni.name: Negroni
method: Pour all ingredients directly into a chilled old-fashioned glass filled with ice.
Stir gently.
garnish: Garnish with half an orange slice.

new-york-sour.name: New York Sour
ingredients: a few drops of egg white
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker and shake vigorously with ice.
Strain into a chilled rocks glass with ice and float the red wine on top.
garnish: Garnish with lemon or orange peel and a cherry.

old-cuban.name: Old Cuban
method: Shake all ingredients except the sparkling wine well with ice and strain into a chilled elegant cocktail glass.
Top up with sparkling wine.
garnish: Garnish with a sprig of mint.

old-fashioned.name: Old Fashioned
ingredients: a few drops of Angostura bitters
method: Place the sugar cube in an old-fashioned glass, soak with bitters and add a few drops of water. Muddle until dissolved, fill with ice and add the whiskey.
Stir gently.
garnish: Garnish with an orange slice or peel and a cocktail cherry.

paloma.name: Paloma
method: Pour the tequila into a highball glass and squeeze in the lime juice.
Add ice and salt, then top up with pink grapefruit soda.
Stir gently.

paper-plane.name: Paper Plane
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

paradise.name: Paradise
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

penicillin.name: Penicillin
method: Muddle the fresh ginger slices in a mixing glass, then add the remaining ingredients except the single malt whisky.
Fill the mixing glass with ice and shake well.
Fine-strain into a chilled old-fashioned glass.
Float the single malt whisky on top.

pina-colada.name: Pina Colada
method: Blend all ingredients with ice in an electric blender.
Pour into a large glass and serve with a straw.
Note: historically a few drops of fresh lime juice were added for flavor. Four slices of fresh pineapple may replace the pineapple juice.
garnish: Garnish with a pineapple slice and a cocktail cherry.

pisco-punch.name: Pisco Punch
method: Lightly muddle the cloves in the sugar syrup, then add the remaining ingredients except the wine.
Shake vigorously and strain into a large stemmed glass.
Top with the wine and stir gently.

pisco-sour.name: Pisco Sour
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice.
Shake and strain into a chilled stemmed glass.
garnish: Add a few drops of Amargo bitters on top as an aromatic garnish.

planters-punch.name: Planter’s Punch
method: Pour all ingredients directly into a small glass or a traditional clay cup.
Note: dilute to taste with cold water, ice or freshly squeezed fruit juice.

porn-star-martini.name: Porn Star Martini
method: Shake all ingredients with ice and double-strain into a large chilled cocktail glass.
Serve with a separate glass of champagne.
garnish: Garnish with a passion fruit shell and sugar.

porto-flip.name: Porto Flip
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker, mix well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
garnish: Sprinkle freshly grated nutmeg on top.

rabo-de-galo.name: Rabo de Galo
method: Put all ingredients in a rocks glass, add ice and stir gently.

ramos-fizz.name: Ramos Fizz
method: Add all ingredients except soda water to a shaker with ice.
Shake for two minutes, strain into a glass, then return the drink to the shaker and shake hard without ice for one minute.
Pour into a highball glass and add soda water.

Note: Henry Ramos created this drink in 1888 at his Meyer’s Table d’Hôtel Internationale bar in New Orleans. Originally a team of 30 bartenders passed the shaker from one to another, shaking continuously for 12 minutes.

remember-the-maine.name: Remember the Maine
method: Pour the absinthe into a coupe and swirl to coat the entire inside.
Discard the absinthe and set the glass aside. Put the other ingredients in a mixing glass about three-quarters full of ice, stir until cold and strain into the absinthe-rinsed glass.

russian-spring-punch.name: Russian Spring Punch
method: Shake all ingredients except the sparkling wine with ice and strain into a chilled tall glass with ice.
Top up with sparkling wine.
garnish: Garnish with blackberries and optionally a lemon slice.

rusty-nail.name: Rusty Nail
method: Pour the ingredients into an old-fashioned glass filled with ice.
Stir gently.

sazerac.name: Sazerac
method: Rinse a chilled old-fashioned glass with absinthe, add crushed ice and set aside. Stir the remaining ingredients with ice in a mixing glass.
Discard the ice and excess absinthe from the prepared glass and strain the mixed drink into it.
Note: after the American Civil War, the original recipe changed because cognac was hard to obtain, and rye whiskey replaced it.

sea-breeze.name: Sea Breeze
method: Put all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
garnish: Garnish with an orange peel strip and a cherry.

sex-on-the-beach.name: Sex on the Beach
method: Put all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
garnish: Garnish with half an orange slice.

sherry-cobbler.name: Sherry Cobbler
method: Put the sherry, sugar, two slices each of orange and lemon, and ice into a shaker; shake briefly and strain into a julep cup filled with crushed ice.
garnish: Garnish with fresh berries and quarter slices of orange and lemon. Serve with a straw.

sidecar.name: Sidecar
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

singapore-sling.name: Singapore Sling
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker filled with ice.
Shake vigorously.
Strain into a hurricane glass.
garnish: Garnish with pineapple and a maraschino cherry.

south-side.name: South Side
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Note: if using egg white, shake vigorously.
garnish: Garnish with a sprig of mint.

spicy-fifty.name: Spicy Fifty
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker and double-strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

spritz.name: Spritz
method: Add all ingredients to a wine glass filled with ice.
Stir gently.
Note: other Spritz versions may use Campari, Cynar or Select instead of Aperol.

stinger.name: Stinger
method: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice and stir well.
Strain into a chilled martini cocktail glass.

suffering-bastard.name: Suffering Bastard
method: Shake all ingredients except the ginger beer with ice in a shaker.
Pour without straining into a Collins glass or an original S. Bastard mug and top with ginger beer.
garnish: Garnish with a mint sprig and optionally an orange slice.

tequila-sunrise.name: Tequila Sunrise
method: Pour the tequila and orange juice directly into a stemmed glass filled with ice.
Add the grenadine to create layered colors like a sunrise; do not stir.
garnish: Garnish with half an orange slice or orange peel.

three-dots-and-a-dash.name: Three Dots and a Dash
method: Put all ingredients in a blender with 12 ounces of crushed ice, blend briefly and pour into a tall clear stemmed glass.
Fill the glass with more crushed ice.
garnish: Garnish with three cherries and a rectangular piece of pineapple.

tipperary.name: Tipperary
method: Pour all ingredients into a mixing glass with ice.
Strain into a chilled martini cocktail glass.

tommys-margarita.name: Tommy’s Margarita
method: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled glass filled with ice.

trinidad-sour.name: Trinidad Sour
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

tuxedo.name: Tuxedo
method: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice and stir well.
Strain into a chilled martini cocktail glass.
garnish: Garnish with a cherry and lemon peel.

ve-n-to.name: Ve.N.To
ingredients: 15 ml honey mix (chamomile in place of water)
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker and shake vigorously with ice.
Strain into a chilled small ceramic cup filled with ice.
Note: if desired, replace the water in the honey mix with chamomile-infused water.
garnish: Garnish with lemon peel and white grapes.

vesper.name: Vesper
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker filled with ice.
Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

vieux-carre.name: Vieux Carré
method: Pour all ingredients into a mixing glass with ice.
Stir well and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
garnish: Garnish with orange peel and a maraschino cherry.

whiskey-sour.name: Whiskey Sour
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker.
Strain into a small glass. If served with ice, strain into an old-fashioned glass filled with ice.
Note: when using egg white, shake harder to release and incorporate its foam.
garnish: Garnish with half an orange slice and a cherry; orange peel is optional.

white-lady.name: White Lady
method: Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

zombie.name: Zombie
method: Put all ingredients in an electric blender with 170 grams of crushed ice.
Pulse for a few seconds and pour into a stemmed glass.
Note: *Donn’s Mix is two parts fresh yellow grapefruit juice to one part cinnamon syrup.
